function: Uplink cascaded channel estimation under beam squint: DnCNN for the quasi-static RIS1-BS channel and Bi-LSTM for the time-varying UE-RIS1 channel (pp. 8-10).
system: N=16 UEs with 4 antennas, K=2 passive reflecting RISs of P=256 elements, 64-antenna UPA at the BS, wideband OFDM, B=500 MHz at fc=60 GHz (p. 10, Table 1).
method: Supervised residual-learning DnCNN (batch normalisation, 3 layers) and Bi-LSTM (3 layers), plus subband division against beam squint and two-timescale estimation; learning rate 10^-6 (pp. 6-11).
data_channel: DeepMIMO O1_60 outdoor scenario at 60 GHz; 20,000 input-output pairs, 70% for training and 30% for validation (p. 10).
test_conditions: Same DeepMIMO O1_60 scenario for training and validation; evaluation sweeps SNR (-10 to 15 dB), subbands Nsb and RIS elements P; no unseen scenario (pp. 10-12).
baselines: Non-learned: OMP-based TS-OMP scheme [18] and Oracle LS bound. Learned: double-structured DnCNN [20]. Proposed scheme without subband division (Nsb=1) also shown (p. 11).
metrics: NMSE in dB versus SNR (-10 to 15 dB), for several Nsb and P; training loss versus iterations to choose the number of layers (pp. 11-12).
complexity: Analytical orders: Bi-LSTM O(8 L_LSTM P (N_inp N_hidd + N_hidd^2)) plus DnCNN convolution term, times Q N_sb; higher than [18] and [20] (pp. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 10: "For training, the DeepMIMO dataset" (scenario O1_60 at 60 GHz, same page); the paper does not describe the test data separately.
q2_support: p. 10: "validation (30%) is 20 000 input-output dataset pairs." Training and validation come from one O1_60 dataset; p. 12: "in TABLE 1 constant but varying the value of P." The results sweep SNR, Nsb and P, and the paper never states that a model trained under one configuration is tested under another.
q3_support: p. 11: "1) OMP-based Scheme in [18]" and "2) Double-structured DnCNN scheme in [20]", benchmarked in NMSE, plus Oracle LS; p. 12: "and [20] by 3.5 dB and 1.5 dB respectively."
q4_support: p. 12: "Thus, the complexity cost of each LSTM is of order" (Bi-LSTM and DnCNN orders given); p. 13: "traded off the computational complexity for high CE accuracy".
q5_support: p. 10: "For training, the DeepMIMO dataset" (public ray-tracing dataset, scenario O1_60); no link to code or data is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: PDF title and DOI match (p. 1). Table 1 values were read from the page image of p. 10 because the table was not extracted as text. DeepMIMO is named for training only; q1 and q5 rest on that statement and on O1_60 being used throughout the simulations, to be confirmed by the reviewer. Figs. 2 and 4 use Nsc=128 while Table 1 lists Nsc=2048.
